description: The pump.fun launches most like this coin at the same age, named by mint, and how each went over its next 24 h (peak, close, dead or graduated): the same deployer's prior launches first, then the nearest of the last 90 days by the deployer's record, the first-10 s buyers, the insiders' share and curve progress, each saying why it is similar. For: coins like this one, what happened to launches like this, comparables. Not a prediction: what launches that looked like this did next. $0.005 a call, USDC on Solana over x402, or a free key.

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

name: similar_launches
